title: 受保护编辑启用入口（旧未保护 Note → d2-v1 原地启用）— fork visual evidence
synthetic_declaration: Real fork Next.js app (next dev --webpack, embedded iframe) + synthetic host page + route-mocked Research Gateway. No real RDLens host, PostgreSQL, SurrealDB, files, models, Feishu content, users or private data. All note titles/ids/content are [synthetic] fixtures (project p1, viewer 1, fabricated claims-only token).

env.layout_probe: MEDIUM-1 round-1 regression guard: real Chromium boundingBox/scroll geometry of the legacy row title column, Delete action and compact enable icon (E1/E3, both widths), plus cross-phase screenshot comparison for unchanged surfaces (E3/E7/E8): DOM-layout equivalence is the hard gate and harness/verify_pixel_equivalence.py performs a tolerant per-pixel comparison (byte sha256 equality is recorded as information, not a gate)
env.round1_fix: round-1 MEDIUM-1: the enable entry is a compact icon button (lucide ShieldCheck, size="icon", aria-label/title = research.notes.catalog.enableProtected) so the legacy row title column is not squeezed at 1024x768; confirming-phase Esc cancels the dialog without a request
